qa_pairs.question: What special tool is needed to press out the input shaft, output shaft and layshaft from the case rear section?
qa_pairs.answer: Special Tool 23 1 050 is needed to press input shaft, output shaft and layshaft out of case rear section.

qa_pairs.question: What should you use to avoid sealing surface damage when pressing out shafts?
qa_pairs.answer: To avoid sealing surface damage, use a piece of wood, aluminum or similar material between claws and sealing surface.

qa_pairs.question: How do you drive out the pin in the 3rd/4th gear selector fork?
qa_pairs.answer: Drive out pin (10) in 3rd/4th gear selector fork, then replace the pin during installation.

qa_pairs.question: What important precaution should you take when knocking out the 3rd/4th gear selector rod?
qa_pairs.answer: Be careful not to clamp selector rods and layshaft while pressing out parts. Lockpin (11) should be secured in selector rod.

qa_pairs.question: How do you engage 2nd and reverse gears during disassembly?
qa_pairs.answer: Engage 2nd and reverse gears by pushing 1st/2nd and 5th/reverse gear selector rods forward.

qa_pairs.question: What should you check during installation of all bearings?
qa_pairs.answer: Check condition of all bearings, replacing if necessary during installation.

qa_pairs.question: Which gear selector rods need to be installed with selector forks?
qa_pairs.answer: Install 3rd/4th gear selector fork and 1st/2nd as well as 5th/reverse gear selector rods with selector forks.

qa_pairs.question: What component should you check when installing gear selector components?
qa_pairs.answer: Check thrust washer (1) when installing gear selector components.

qa_pairs.question: What should you remove from the case rear section during disassembly?
qa_pairs.answer: Remove all detent and locking balls in case rear section.

qa_pairs.question: How should roller bearings be installed in the case?
qa_pairs.answer: Install roller bearings with large diameter end facing out.

qa_pairs.question: What lubrication is required during reassembly?
qa_pairs.answer: Lubricate lockpin and locking lever with oil during reassembly.

qa_pairs.question: What does callout number 10 indicate in the gear selector fork procedure?
qa_pairs.answer: Callout number 10 indicates the pin that needs to be driven out of the 3rd/4th gear selector fork.
